pages.text: Pylons can be found in Vaults.$(br2)$(l)Right-click$() one and you and your party members within 10 blocks get its buff. Look at a Pylon to see what it does.$(br2)Used Pylons go dark. Breaking one instead can drop a $(l)Temporal Relic$().

pages.title: Effects
pages.text: The Pylons are:$(br)$(li)$(l)Time$(): more time for the whole party$(li)$(l)Refill$(): fills your potion$(li)$(l)Brimming$(): +1 potion charge$(li)$(l)Infused$(): an extra potion slot$(li)$(l)Mana$(): fills your mana$(li)$(l)Restore$(): heals you to full$(li)$(l)Swiftness$(): more speed
